parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is required.
- If a subsequent query is required, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: PrefixListId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the prefix list to query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the prefix list to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.
